notes.heading: Block 211
items: Retail is allowed, but portable kiosks are not.
Gas station and restaurant with drive-through are allowed with a special use permit; they are not allowed in other blocks.
Exempt from the build-to line and façade requirements, the 200 to 750 ft block length, the 80% masonry rule, the landscaping rules, and the sustainability program.

notes: Outside Block 211, retail is allowed only as part of a mixed use, or from a portable kiosk (25 to 500 sq ft). Free-standing retail is prohibited.
Off-premises beer and wine sales are allowed with a special use permit in Blocks 209, 210, and 211 only.
The whole PD counts as one lot for parking and open space, and each phase must still meet the parking standards.
Shared parking is allowed when uses peak at different times, based on a parking study approved by the director of development services. Below-grade parking may extend to the lot lines.
Parking garages: no ramps expressed on street-facing facades, and no steel garages or steel guard cables.
Bicycle parking is required for all multifamily and commercial uses.
A development plan approved by Planning and Zoning and Council is required before permits.
Council may waive any development standard with a development plan, but not to add a use or raise intensity or density.
